FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(SETIAWANGSA-PANTAI EXPRESSWAY) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads

(Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Setiawangsa-Pantai Expressway) (Amendment) Order 2023.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 3 December 2023.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls)

(Setiawangsa-Pantai Expressway) Order 2022 [P.U. (A) 38/2022], which is referred to

as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended by substituting for paragraph 2

the following paragraph:

"Authorization to collect tolls

2. (1) Lebuhraya DUKE Fasa 3 Sdn. Bhd is authorized—

(a) for the period from 1 March 2022 to 4 August 2079

to demand, collect and retain the appropriate tolls

specified in column (2) of the First Schedule for

the use in either direction, by the classes of vehicles specified

in column (1) of the First Schedule, of any part of the road

known as the Setiawangsa-Pantai Expressway commencing

from the main line at kilometre 16.40

at coordinates N 352706.499, E 415985.744

of the Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric Datum

of Malaysia (GDM2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 20.67

at coordinates N 355959.040, E 415610.971 of

the RSO GDM2000 Grid, including part of Setiawangsa

Interchange and entire Genting Kelang Interchange,

Genting Kelang On Ramp, Taman Melati Interchange,

Wangsa Maju Toll Plaza as well as its link roads, being

a distance of 4.27 kilometres; and

(b) for the period from 3 December 2023 to 4 August 2079

to demand, collect and retain the appropriate tolls specified

in column (2) of the First A Schedule for the use in either

direction, by the classes of vehicles specified in column (1) of

the First A Schedule, of any part of the road known

as the Setiawangsa-Pantai Expressway commencing from

the main line at kilometre -0.031 at coordinates

N 345048.296, T 407457.781 of the RSO GDM2000

Grid and ending at kilometre 16.400 at coordinates

N 352706.498, E 415985.744 of the RSO GDM2000 Grid,

including part of Kerinchi Interchange, On and Off Ramps

at Jalan Kelang Lama, Salak Interchange, Pandan

Interchange, Ampang Interchange,Setiawangsa Interchange,

Chan Sow Lin Toll Plaza, Ampang Toll Plaza, Setiawangsa

Toll Plaza as well as its link roads, being

a distance of 15.711 kilometres.

(2) The roads specified—

(a) in subsubparagraph (1)(a) for the use of which tolls

are authorized to be demanded, collected and retained

are shown on the map in the Second Schedule; and

(b) in subsubparagraph (1)(b) for the use of which tolls

are authorized to be demanded, collected and retained

are shown on the map in the Second A Schedule.".

Amendment of First Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended in the heading of the First Schedule by

substituting for the words "Subparagraph 2(1)" the words "Subsubparagraph 2(1)(a)".

New First A Schedule

4. The principal Order is amended by inserting after the First Schedule

the following schedule:

"FIRST A SCHEDULE

[Subsubparagraph 2(1)(b)]
